decision.observation: The Outhouse is still under construction. No Metal Ore is stored, and a speckled tan deposit below the starting room may be a different material from the surrounding Sandstone.
decision.hypothesis: Inspecting that nearby deposit will identify a potential Metal Ore source for the Oxygen Diffuser without ordering risky excavation.
decision.memory: Oxygen Diffuser requires 200 kg Metal Ore, 120 W power, and Algae. Algae is visible above the starting room. Keep the left reservoir sealed; the farther right-side dig orders are unreachable.
